name: Temple Street
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. There a quite a few people here, many of them
desc3: robed in white cowled robes. You cannot help but notice the huge,
desc4: garishly-painted building to the south. An immense, painted sign
desc5: glimmers and magically flashes the words "Lucky Strike Casino". Its
desc6: large golden doors are closed, and a sign says "New Grand Reopening!"
desc7: and under that a nicer sign says "Open by order of Silvermere Council"
